emily (sec-eng): Heads up — a few APAC tenants report RBAC changes not landing after last night's KMS alias update. SCIM returns 204 but role.apply shows crypto errors.

rahul (infra): which hosts? any log snippets?

emily (sec-eng): ap-southeast-1 hosts. example from provisioner on ap-southeast-1e:

```
2026-05-02T02:12:09Z provisioner[pid=502]: ERROR apply-role tenant=omega user=frank@omega err=KMS:sign failed: key not found alias/rdw/prov/2026-05-02 corr=tx-7c1e
2026-05-02T02:12:09Z provisioner[pid=502]: WARN queued deprov id=6d2f retry=exponential
2026-05-02T02:12:12Z provisioner[pid=502]: INFO scim/patch -> 204
```

jess (sre): audit pipeline shows a drop for role.grant events in that window. securitybot, confirm.

securitybot: Alert: audit.role_grant.ingest_drop triggered 2026-05-02T02:15:00Z. drop_count=39 in 5m window.

vault-bot: Vault shard ap-southeast-1 replication lag detected; last_sync=2026-05-02T01:58:40Z, pending_replicas=2/4.

rahul (infra): sounds like bootstrap ran, wrote new alias, but secret injection failed due to vault lag -> agent lacked KEY_ID -> crypto ops fail. Can someone run quick checks on affected nodes?

jess (sre): commands to run on node:
```
sudo cat /etc/rdw/kms_alias || echo missing
sudo cat /etc/rdw/kms_key_id || echo missing
sudo journalctl -u rdw-bootstrap --since "2026-05-02 00:00" | tail -n 100
curl -sS http://127.0.0.1:9250/health | jq .provisioner_status
```

emily (sec-eng): ran on 1e: kms_alias=alias/rdw/prov/2026-05-02, kms_key_id="". bootstrap log shows secret fetch error: secret not present in shard.

rahul (infra): remediation plan: (1) emergency-inject key_id from primary to affected hosts, (2) restart bootstrap and provisioner services, (3) replay queued deprov actions, (4) collect logs/evidence and upload to /shared/sec-incidents/1899991111/.

jess (sre): also add metric and alert: agent.kms_key_id_present (0/1) and audit.ingest_miss_rate for role events. Postmortem items: block alias rotation until vault replication healthy; make bootstrap fail-fast when critical secret missing; add rollout pre-check.

emily (sec-eng): collecting evidence: grep KMS: lines and correlation ids to map to audit. Will scrub PII then upload.

ops-bot: emergency patch applied to ap-southeast-1e and 1f: key_id written, services restarted.

rahul (infra): seeing KMS:sign success and queued actions drain. Audit ingest rate back to baseline in ~60s.

jess (sre): assigning follow-ups: @rahul runbook PR for pre-checks, @emily audit backfill, @jess monitoring alerts.

emily (sec-eng): thanks — incident logged and evidence uploaded. reopening if anything regresses.

securitybot: Incident recorded INC-20260502-9971 severity=medium status=mitigated
